# Parley v0.1.6

This corrective beta makes Finder and Terminal launches behave consistently,
and closes two process-boundary defects exposed while diagnosing workspace
creation from the installed app.

## Fixed

- Opening a workspace after launching Parley from Finder no longer fails with
  **“Parley could not safely identify the workspace tmux created”**. tmux field
  parsing now uses a printable namespaced separator that remains unchanged
  under Finder's minimal locale.
- Child commands are started with controlled file descriptors. tmux and other
  descendants can no longer retain Parley's production UI lock after the UI
  quits, so a normal Finder reopen does not report a phantom duplicate window.
- Command output capture no longer waits for pipe EOF from a daemon descendant.
  Short-lived tmux clients can return their bounded response while the private
  tmux server continues running.
- The primary SwiftUI scene now permits one Parley window per runtime instead
  of allowing an extra production window to compete for the same UI lease.
- Finder-launched builds declare `LANG=C.UTF-8` through the signed app's
  `LSEnvironment`. The embedded core LaunchAgent declares the same value, and
  direct or Development starts receive it only when no explicit character
  locale is present.

## Verification

- Three consecutive workspaces were created through the native folder picker
  in a Parley process launched by Finder, followed by a normal Quit and Finder
  reopen with the production UI lock released.
- A real isolated tmux lifecycle runs under a Finder-like `C` locale as part of
  the deterministic checks.
- Regression checks cover UI-lock descriptor inheritance, daemon output
  capture, both output streams, Launch Services child output and preservation
  of explicit locale configuration.
- The complete deterministic suite contains 144 native checks plus the
  packaging, security, public-history and VS Code companion checks.

## Install and upgrade

- Apple Silicon Mac running macOS 14 or later.
- `tmux` and at least one supported, installed and signed-in vendor CLI.
- Download `Parley-0.1.6-mac-arm64.dmg`, quit Parley, replace `Parley.app` in
  Applications, and reopen it normally from Finder.
- Existing tmux panes, workspace folders, layouts, context and collaboration
  history remain under `~/Library/Application Support/Parley Native`.
- This beta is ad-hoc signed and is **not notarized**. Use **System Settings →
  Privacy & Security → Open Anyway** only when the files came from this expected
  release. Never disable Gatekeeper globally.

Use `Parley-0.1.6-mac-arm64.SHA256SUMS` to verify every downloaded artifact.
